zh-CN.bots.channels.add.source.existing: 使用已在 WinOne 设置的机器人
zh-CN.bots.groupChat.errors.hostNotReady: WinOne 还在准备中，请稍后重试
zh-CN.bots.groupChat.loadFailedDescription: WinOne 暂时读不到这个群的消息。你可以重试，或返回伙伴页。
zh-CN.bots.import.databaseDriver: 数据库驱动无法加载，请更新或修复 WinOne 后重试。
zh-CN.bots.sessionLoadFailedDescription: 任务关联仍然存在，但 WinOne 暂时无法读取伙伴状态。你可以重试，或返回伙伴总览。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.authorization.descrip: 即将跳转到腾讯提供的网页完成授权。扫码绑定后，即可在微信中与伙伴对话。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.authorization.rebindD: 当前微信已有连接。继续扫码可能解除该微信原有的其他连接（例如 OpenClaw）。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.authorization.rebindT: 将新的 WinOne 连接到微信
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.authorization.steps.3: 绑定成功后回到 WinOne，连接状态会自动更新。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.bound.notes.connected: 微信私聊消息会直接进入本机 WinOne，不经过 WinOne 服务器转发。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.companion.permissionN: 你在微信中发给伙伴的消息沿用伙伴的权限设置，包括完全访问。可在 OneBot 对话输入框下方切换权限；其他人的消息仍受权限限制。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.errorNote: 本次连接未完成。请确认网络正常后重新扫码；WinOne 不会在连接失败时保存明文凭证。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.intro: 连接后，你发给该微信连接的私聊消息会进入本机 WinOne。授权网页由腾讯提供，页面中可能显示 OpenClaw。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.unbind.description: 解绑会停止收发、删除本机微信凭证并清理未完成的执行。已创建的任务、历史消息和已保存附件会保留。
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.workingDir.managed: 使用 WinOne 管理的专用目录
zh-CN.settings.wechatBot.workingDir.unavailabl: 已选目录当前不可访问；新对话将暂时使用 WinOne 管理的专用目录。
zh-CN.chat.remoteFile.previewUnsupported: 此连接不支持预览此目录。
zh-CN.chat.remoteFile.folderUnsupported: 此连接不支持传输文件夹。
zh-CN.chat.remoteFile.downloadUnsupported: 此连接不支持下载文件夹。
zh-CN.bots.remoteSettings.unsupported: 请更新另一台设备上的 WinOne 以编辑这些设置。
zh-CN.bots.capabilities.core.hint: 开任务、联系伙伴、换模型、用工具和插件、记忆。随 WinOne 更新。
zh-CN.bots.capabilities.core.meta: 所有伙伴共用 · 始终开启 · 随 WinOne 更新
zh-CN.bots.capabilities.core.items.self.title: 了解与设置 WinOne
zh-CN.bots.capabilities.core.items.self.body: 了解 WinOne 的功能和用法，按你的要求查询、调整设置；需要你填写或确认时，在任务里交给你完成。
zh-CN.bots.capabilities.system.pageMeta: 系统技能 · 随 WinOne 更新

en.bots.channels.add.source.existing: Use the bot already set up in WinOne
en.bots.groupChat.errors.hostNotReady: WinOne is still getting ready. Try again in a moment.
en.bots.groupChat.loadFailedDescription: WinOne can’t read this group chat right now. Try again, or go back to Teammates.
en.bots.import.databaseDriver: The database driver could not load. Update or repair WinOne, then retry.
en.bots.sessionLoadFailedDescription: The task link is valid, but WinOne could not read the teammate state. Retry or return to the teammate overview.
en.settings.wechatBot.authorization.descrip: Tencent's webpage will open for authorization. After scanning, you can talk to your teammate from WeChat.
en.settings.wechatBot.authorization.rebindD: This WeChat account already has a connection. Continuing may replace its existing connection, such as OpenClaw.
en.settings.wechatBot.authorization.rebindT: Connect a new WinOne to WeChat
en.settings.wechatBot.authorization.steps.3: Return to WinOne after binding; the connection status updates automatically.
en.settings.wechatBot.bound.notes.connected: WeChat private messages go directly to WinOne on this computer and are not relayed through WinOne servers.
en.settings.wechatBot.companion.permissionN: Your WeChat messages to this teammate use its permission settings, including Full access. Change permissions below the OneBot chat input. Messages from other people remain restricted.
en.settings.wechatBot.errorNote: The connection was not completed. Check your network and scan again. WinOne never stores plaintext credentials after a failed connection.
en.settings.wechatBot.intro: After connecting, private messages sent to this WeChat connection enter WinOne on this computer. Tencent provides the authorization page, which may display OpenClaw.
en.settings.wechatBot.unbind.description: Unbinding stops messaging, removes local WeChat credentials, and clears unfinished tasks. Existing sessions, history, and saved attachments remain.
en.settings.wechatBot.waiting.note: Finish scanning and confirmation in your system browser. WinOne updates automatically when it succeeds, or you can cancel this attempt.
en.settings.wechatBot.workingDir.unavailabl: The selected directory is unavailable. New conversations temporarily use a WinOne-managed directory.
en.chat.remoteFile.previewUnsupported: This connection cannot preview this directory.
en.bots.remoteSettings.unsupported: Update WinOne on the other device to edit these settings.
en.bots.capabilities.core.hint: Tasks, other teammates, models, tools and plugins, memory. Updated with WinOne.
en.bots.capabilities.core.meta: Shared by all teammates · Always on · Updated with WinOne
en.bots.capabilities.core.items.self.title: Knowing and configuring WinOne
en.bots.capabilities.core.items.self.body: Understands WinOne’s features and usage, and checks or changes settings as you request. Asks you in the task when your input or confirmation is needed.
